program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((count9 (count-where (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) 9)) (range 0 (cols g))))
         (clean (for/fold ([out g]) ([c (in-range (cols g))])
                  (if (= (at g 0 c) 9) (set-cell out 0 c 0) out)))
         (obj (crop-to-content clean 0)))
    (cond [(= count9 1) (rotate-cw obj)]
          [(= count9 2) (rotate-180 obj)]
          [else (transpose obj)])))
